purpose: The two cheap follow-ups named in the label-similarity-v1 digest, run because v1 returned a null and both hypotheses for why are testable in one run each. Probe 1 lowers the mixing weight, on the theory that 0.3 distorted the embedding geometry more than the label signal was worth. Probe 2 keeps the weight and restricts the target to the findings the reports actually comment on, on the theory that masking noise from mostly-UNK findings diluted it.
baseline: checkpoints/contrastive/label-similarity-v1/lambda00-seed2026, already trained; not retrained here because every argument except the two label settings is identical and the v1 run is only hours old under the same code state.

finding_selection_rule.rule: UNK rate <= 10% over the 4,406 labelled studies, applied before any run.
finding_selection_rule.note: The v1 digest named 'Effusion, Medial Meniscus, ACL and PF OA' off-hand. PF OA is 18.5% UNK and does not survive the stated rule; MCL at 9.8% does. Lateral Meniscus misses by 0.03pp. The rule is what selected the set, not the earlier list.

pre_registered_hazard: Restricting to 4 binary findings admits at most 16 distinct clinical profiles, so the target gets COARSER even though co-observation gets denser. Measured before launch at batch 32: 7 distinct off-diagonal values (vs 46 for all 12), 16.4% of pairs exactly 1.0 (vs 6.0%), and 92.6% of rows carrying a perfect-agreement rival (vs 68.6%). Probe 2 is therefore expected to behave closer to label smoothing than to a semantic similarity target. It is run anyway because that prediction is worth confirming and costs one run.
selection_policy: mean_r@1 descending, validation_loss ascending, earliest epoch
noise_floor: Single seed per arm. Two runs of one config at one seed differ by 0.0237 in selected mean_r@1 and ~0.0087 per epoch (median), measured in label-similarity-v1. Nothing smaller than that is resolvable here.
known_confound: Unchanged from v1: the labels are extracted FROM the reports, so label agreement is a lossy compression of the text side rather than independent supervision, and the 12 findings are exactly those the downstream probe scores.
